evidence: I independently read the exact changed opening sentence against its source and the complete surrounding paragraph, with the preceding Hearthwork discussion visible. The source’s “your support person were a lover” could attach the just-described peer to the romantic role. “Your support came from a lover” instead names a possible source of support without identifying the peer as that lover. The change preserves the tentative “Maybe you’d rather,” the desire for support associated with romance, and “as well,” while adding no advice, fact, or autobiographical claim. The opening still leads naturally into “Lots of people open a dating app in the middle of the night,” and the rest of the paragraph is unchanged. I assessed all 33 inventory IDs on this sentence and found no inventory operation present; individual literal evidence is in cold_two_inventory.json. Both actual mechanical REVIEW labels were examined: single-sentence source order is appropriate, and the two retained second-person forms do not establish heavy cumulative coaching at this 12-word scope. No detector calls or unrelated factual review were performed.
